g.text: Use case diagram 0 — Sethika system context
Give online / pledge to a need
Every signed-in person is a Registered user; Donor, Applicant, Institution staff and
Platform admin are what they can do, given by roles and permissions (RBAC), not separate accounts.
Detail: use case diagrams 1 (donor), 2 (institution staff), 3 (onboarding and platform).
